lines.en: Three sites in a row, never two neighbours lit, give five states. Fix how often each site is lit, and one number is still free: how often both ends are lit together. This film follows that hidden number.
lines.zh: 一排三个格位、相邻两位不能同时点亮，共有五种状态。固定每个格位被点亮的频率，仍有一个数是自由的：两端同时点亮的频率。这部片子追踪这个隐藏的数。

lines.en: AURIC circulation control, part one: one loop, a KL action and the four-corner swap.
lines.zh: AURIC 环流控制，第一部：一个环、KL 作用量与四角交换。

lines.en: One relation among five states becomes a circulation charge, a convex action, one binomial and a two-copy exchange.
lines.zh: 五个状态之间的一条关系，依次成为环流荷、凸的作用量、唯一的二项式和两份副本的交换。

lines.en: Read each state as an edge from its first two sites to its last two. The four states without the middle site close a square; the middle state lies in a second component. Edges minus vertices plus components: five minus six plus two, one loop.
lines.zh: 把每个状态读作从前两位指向后两位的一条边。不含中位的四个状态围成一个方环；中位状态落在第二个分量里。边数减顶点数加分量数：5 − 6 + 2 = 1，恰好一个环。

lines.en: With the boundary fixed, kappa moves only along the circulation h, plus one, minus one, zero, minus one, plus one. Site frequencies cannot see it: the weighted mean pairs with h to zero, its square to twenty, and one nonzero pairing recovers kappa.
lines.zh: 固定边界后，κ 只沿环流方向 h = (1, −1, 0, −1, 1) 变化。格位频率看不见它：加权均值与 h 的配对为 0，其平方的配对为 20；只要一个非零配对就能恢复 κ。

lines.en: Fix the site frequencies and score kappa by its relative entropy to the independent point, kappa zero equals X Y over one minus Z. The slope is the log odds ratio, the curvature a sum of four reciprocals, so the minimum is unique.
lines.zh: 固定格位频率，用 κ 到条件独立点 κ₀ = XY/(1 − Z) 的相对熵为它打分。斜率是对数优势比，曲率是四个倒数之和，所以极小点唯一。

lines.en: No hidden adjustment repairs the base. Around a five-cycle, every window can be half one-zero-one, half zero-one-zero, all overlaps consistent, yet the total occupancy, five halves, exceeds two, the largest independent set.
lines.zh: 隐藏调整修不好基础层。在五环上，每个窗口都可取一半 101、一半 010，所有重叠都相容；但总占用 5/2 超过最大独立集的大小 2。

lines.en: Integers carry a fiber of the same shape. Trading two times five for seven keeps the leaf counts and moves kappa, the power of seven: seven thousand two hundred, five thousand forty, three thousand five hundred twenty-eight, each step times seven tenths.
lines.zh: 整数里有形状相同的纤维。用 7 换掉 2 × 5，叶计数不变，变的是 κ，即 7 的幂：7200、5040、3528，每一步乘以 7/10。

lines.en: In the golden ring, the atoms one, theta, theta squared and two plus theta have norms one, minus one, one and five, so the power of five in the norm reads kappa: zero, one, two along this fiber.
lines.zh: 在黄金环中，原子 1、θ、θ² 与 2 + θ 的范数依次为 1、−1、1、5，所以范数中 5 的幂次读出 κ：沿这条纤维依次为 0、1、2。

lines.en: Among the five pattern columns, recording mass and three occupations, every integer relation is a multiple of one: empty plus joint equals low plus high, both two, one, one, zero.
lines.zh: 五个模式列（记录质量与三个占位）之间的每条整数关系都是同一条关系的倍数：空 + 联合 = 低 + 高，两边都是 (2, 1, 1, 0)。

lines.en: Lifted to monomials, the kernel of the toric map is generated by one binomial, p zero p thirteen minus p one p three. On the fiber it equals one minus Z, times kappa, minus X Y, zero exactly at the independent point.
lines.zh: 提升到单项式后，toric 映射的核由唯一的二项式 p₀p₁₃ − p₁p₃ 生成。在纤维上它等于 (1 − Z)κ − XY，恰在条件独立点为零。

lines.en: Now join two windows: the last site of one and the first of the next may not both be lit, leaving twenty-one legal pairs. With fixed marginals, one grouped coupling, P star, has the least mutual information.
lines.zh: 把两个窗口接起来：前一窗的末位与后一窗的首位不能同时点亮，剩下 21 个合法配对。固定边缘后，唯一的分组耦合 P* 使互信息最小。

lines.en: For uniform marginals that minimum is log five minus six fifths log three, about point two nine one. Two other couplings share the marginals, the entropy and the excess divergence, yet a five-cycle target scores minus eleven twentieths and twenty-one twentieths.
lines.zh: 边缘均匀时，这个最小值为 log 5 − (6/5) log 3 ≈ 0.291。另两个耦合的边缘、熵和超出的散度都相同，但五环目标分别给出 −11/20 与 21/20。

lines.en: Along a chain, divergence from that reference splits into pairing terms and long-history terms. Words of empty and middle windows isolate the second kind: even and odd parity agree on every proper subset, yet each lies log two away.
lines.zh: 沿一条链，相对该参考的散度分解为配对项与长历史项。只用空窗与中窗的词把第二类单独分出：偶、奇两种校验律在每个真子集上都相同，却都离参考 log 2。

lines.en: Legal words of N windows number F of three N plus two: five, twenty-one, eighty-nine, three hundred seventy-seven. Fixing every window's marginal leaves zero, twelve, seventy-six and three hundred sixty free directions.
lines.zh: N 个窗口的合法词共有 F(3N + 2) 个：5、21、89、377。固定每个窗口的边缘后，剩下 0、12、76、360 个自由方向。

lines.en: A finite Robin target keeps every prime address: recursion over the primes up to B returns the largest ratio of sigma n over n to e to the gamma log log n above five thousand forty; below one, Robin holds up to B.
lines.zh: 有限 Robin 目标保留每个素数地址：对不超过 B 的素数递推，根值是 5040 < n ≤ B 上 σ(n)/n 与 e^γ log log n 之比的最大值；小于一即 Robin 在 B 以内成立。

lines.en: A frozen Lean theorem covers every n from five thousand forty to two hundred twenty-three million. With primes up to thirty-seven, sigma n over n stays below six point seven two four, so under two stated bounds every such n past two to the sixty-four passes.
lines.zh: 冻结的 Lean 定理已覆盖 5040 < n < 223092870 的每个 n。素因子都不超过 37 时 σ(n)/n < 6.724，所以在两个明示的常数界下，这类 n 只要不小于 2⁶⁴ 也都满足。

lines.en: Lift the relation to five boson modes, with H equal to A dagger A, where A is a one a three minus a zero a thirteen. Each fixed-charge sector is a birth-death chain in disguise: hypergeometric balance, eigenvalues j times R minus j plus one.
lines.zh: 把这条关系提升到五个玻色模：Ĥ = Â†Â，其中 Â = a₁a₃ − a₀a₁₃。每个固定荷扇区都相似于一条生灭链：平衡律为超几何分布，特征值为 j(R − j + 1)。

lines.en: So each sector has one zero-energy ray and, unless trivial, gap R. At degree m those rays add up to one, five, fourteen, thirty, fifty-five, the lattice points of m times the pyramid.
lines.zh: 所以每个扇区恰有一条零能射线，非平凡时谱隙为 R。在次数 m，这些射线合计 1、5、14、30、55 条，正是 m 倍金字塔的格点数。

lines.en: The smallest sector has two states, spectrum zero and two. From one state the unitary evolution reaches the other with probability sine squared t; the Markov chain with the same spectrum relaxes as one minus e to the minus two t, over two.
lines.zh: 最小的扇区只有两个状态，谱为 {0, 2}。从一个状态出发，酉演化到达另一状态的概率是 sin² t；同谱的 Markov 链则按 (1 − e^(−2t))/2 弛豫。

lines.en: Same spectrum, different time laws. The states L plus or minus i R share every mean occupation, yet under the same evolution n thirteen starts to rise or fall at rate one.
lines.zh: 同谱，却是不同的时间律。态 (L ± iR)/√2 的每个平均占位都相同，但在同一演化下 n₁₃ 以速率 1 开始上升或下降。

lines.en: With two distinguishable copies, the only smallest exchange keeping mass and all three occupations swaps empty and joint for low and high. From two equal preparations, each copy's kappa moves by minus delta sine squared u, plus R sine chi sine two u.
lines.zh: 两份可区分的副本中，保持质量和三个占位的最小交换只有一种：把空与联合换成低与高。从两次相同的准备出发，每份的 κ 变化 −Δ sin² u + R sin χ sin 2u。

lines.en: So uniform laws with phase zero never move, while phase pi over two gives one fifth plus one twenty-fifth sine two u. Re-pairing fresh copies each round instead contracts the defect: delta becomes Z times delta.
lines.zh: 所以均匀律在相位 0 时永不移动，相位 π/2 时 κ′ = 1/5 + (1/25) sin 2u。若每轮改用新的独立副本重新配对，缺陷就收缩：Δ 变为 ZΔ。

lines.en: On a path of n sites, an integer trade of legal histograms keeping every moment up to order r needs at least two to the r copies per side, and exists exactly when r is below half of n, rounded up.
lines.zh: 在 n 个格位的路径上，保持直到 r 阶全部矩的合法直方图整数交换，每侧至少需要 2ʳ 份副本；它存在当且仅当 r 小于 n/2 向上取整。

lines.en: Isolating one moment of order k costs two to the k minus one. On nine sites, eighty-nine legal sets leave fifty-one directions beyond order two, and isolating orders three, four and five costs four, eight and sixteen.
lines.zh: 单独改变一个 k 阶矩的代价是 2ᵏ⁻¹。九个格位上有 89 个合法集合，二阶以上留下 51 个方向；孤立三、四、五阶矩分别需要 4、8、16 份。

lines.en: One loop and a blind mean, a convex action, a seven-tenths step, one binomial, a seam minimum, long-history parity, a finite Robin target, a hypergeometric spectrum, two clocks, a phase-driven swap and trades of size two to the r.
lines.zh: 一个环与看不见它的均值、凸的作用量、7/10 的步长、唯一的二项式、接缝最小值、长历史中的奇偶、有限 Robin 目标、超几何谱、两种时钟、由相位驱动的交换，以及规模为 2ʳ 的交易。

lines.en: Robin's criterion, the Bernoulli-Laplace chain and minimal trades are published inputs, Robin's inequality below two hundred twenty-three million is frozen in Lean, the rest is argued in the theory volume, and the finite computations were redone for this film.
lines.zh: Robin 判据、Bernoulli–Laplace 链与最小交易是已发表的输入；2.23 亿以下的 Robin 不等式已在 Lean 中冻结；其余由理论卷论证，有限计算为本片重新完成。
